source_metric: One independent definition, declaration or statement per line; pure function composition contains no packed or nested assignments.
block_generator: Numeric stages [width, rotation0, ...] fold widths N..2. Native index = col + (col<width)*(((col+rotation[row]) mod width)-col); native flat select adds row*N and restores shape.
worker_ranges: One Result expression composes ordinary spawn/wait over [floor(j*Total/T), floor((j+1)*Total/T)), T=min(8,Total). Multiplication precedes division.
work_policy: Every global rank occurs once; each initial permutation and all actual prefix reversals are verified. Blocks clamp at End, checksums use global parity, only the joined parent prints.
diagnostic_policy: Production outputs execute the exact composed source. Trace/gate diagnostics expand only Result into equivalent named range/worker/join expressions with exact worker/range string assertions; flip recorder returns ordered worker records without concurrent stdout.

FlipIndex   ← ⨬(⋅∘|˜-) ⊃(≤|∘|⋅∘)
~FlipState {Permutations Counts}
FlipStep ← FlipState ⊃(≡⊏ ⊃(⊞FlipIndex ⊃(≡⊢FlipState.Permutations|⋅(⇡N)))FlipState.Permutations|+⊃FlipState.Counts(>0≡⊢FlipState.Permutations))

native_runtime_proof.conclusion: The original optimized source tables FlipIndex, a nonprimitive switch composition, per lane/column cell before row gathering.
The generic table fallback pushes each pair of values and interprets the tabled function for every cell.
Single-primitive and flipped-single-primitive tables dispatch to native byte/numeric array routines.
Ordinary numeric comparison and subtraction tables dispatch to fast_table_list; the default opt feature also enables flipped subtraction.
The native primitive table constructs its complete array with host primitive loops and no Uiua env.exec per cell. This is an existing general array primitive, not an added benchmark kernel.
Ordinary pervasive arithmetic supports singleton broadcasting and matching leading axes for row offsets.
A flat ordinary select visits every supplied index and copies the selected values in native array code without executing a user function per row.
Rows Select is absent from the primitive dyadic row-fast-path set, so the compact row gather still has ordinary per-row dispatch. The optimized flat select removes this dispatch.

Normal compiler pre-evaluation is bounded by purity and 1000 elements. N and ranks come from runtime argument/state expressions; no full n=12 permutation or flip-result table is supplied.
Ordinary spawn captures the worker arguments and executes the Uiua function on one native OS thread. Explicit spawn is used; the host-sized pool branch is not used.
Waiting for the handle array returns every worker result in handle order before parent output.
